description: IDOR / BOLA hunting - two-account methodology, identifier discovery and UUID leak chaining, the trusted-identifier test, GraphQL node and nested-object IDOR, cross-tenant escalation, write and delete operations. Bounded ID sampling, never range sweeps. Wiki-first, FIND schema output. Trigger on IDOR, BOLA, broken access control, object level authorization, cross-tenant, "read another user's data", "swap the id", or any API path or parameter carrying a numeric ID, UUID, or account identifier.
